publication_rule: Only an explicit boolean published: true is public. Missing, quoted, duplicated, or inferred values are private and blocked.

naming.folders: A/B/C prefixes exist only to order folders. Do not add a D number merely to order articles.
naming.durable_files: 简短且能表达内容的标题.md
naming.legacy_files: Existing Dn-* and YYYY-MM-DD-* names may remain; do not rename them without a separate redirect plan.

categories.purpose: 日记、工作日志、生活记录、阶段回顾
年/月/周/日计划、目标、职业规划
有明确结果的项目文档、设计、开发记录与成果
经过整理、未来可复用的知识与阅读笔记

hard_rules: Preserve the source published value exactly; never infer true.
When classification confidence is low, retain the source and request review.
Do not overwrite an existing target.
Keep a Markdown file and its relative local images together.
Folder hierarchy is the website hierarchy; frontmatter categories are derived from it.
Never delete, commit, or push from a language-model response. Use deterministic scripts.
